class_id: an exchange that does not carry an issue is read as an answer (settles the type) or as a failure (instant BLOCKED_ALL)
feature: document discovery chain (scraper/src/services/document-discovery-runner.ts): the exchange verdict that decides whether SEBI, the company site and the verifier are consulted
symptom: any source whose reply means 'I do not list this issue' is a THIRD kind of reply, an abstention (OD-60), yet the chain only knew two: answered or failed. (a) NSE returns HTTP 200 for ANY symbol; for an issue it does not list the body is `issueInfo: {}`, which was recorded `ok` - so an SME-on-BSE issue was 'settled' by NSE, the SEBI/company/verifier rungs were skipped (`exchanges_settled_it`), and after 5 slots the row escalated to BLOCKED_ALL with nothing but NSE ever asked. (b) when every consulted exchange only abstained (`not_on_board`, `no_symbol`) no reply was 'ok', so the verdict became EXCHANGES:failed and the row went BLOCKED_ALL (P2) on its first concluded chain, although nothing failed. Universal shape: a verdict built from 'did anyone say ok' misreads an empty-but-200 payload as an answer and an all-abstain round as an outage.
first_seen: 2026-09-26 -- #632, staging read-only through the tunnel: 482 BLOCKED_ALL rows on 108 IPOs. Group A 211 rows / 62 IPOs settled by exchanges (181 rows / 44 SME IPOs by `NSE:ok` alone); live GET of those 44 NSE ipo-detail?series=SME URLs: 29 return 200 with `issueInfo: {}` (e.g. PESHWA, ROBOKIDZ, FXML), 15 carry a dataList. Group B 212 rows 'EXCHANGES:failed' of which 159 had only abstentions (122 NSE:no_symbol, 37 BSE:not_on_board+NSE:no_symbol) and 51 NSE:unknown_segment (a null segment on our row, correctly still failed).
fix_prs: fix/632-blocked-all: NSE empty issueInfo -> outcome `not_carried`; EXCHANGE_ABSTAIN_OUTCOMES counts as answered-without-link, never as coverage; exchange coverage additionally needs at least one exchange `ok`. Tests: scraper/tests/unit/services/document-discovery-exchange-abstain.test.ts (real PESHWA payload fixture). Existing rows are not repaired (no DB writes in #632); they re-enter the chain on their next due attempt.
detection_check: none new. m_blocked_all_age still ages BLOCKED_ALL rows but cannot tell an abstain-caused row from a real outage. A useful check: nightly count of open document rows whose last_attempt has only abstaining exchange outcomes and a chain containing `exchanges_settled_it` or starting `EXCHANGES:failed` -- should fall to 0 after the fix deploys.
